description: Order in the court! The Presidential department is the executive branch of KABA, overseeing the general flow of the club. They lead the planning of the monthly Kaba Konnect events that bring general and executive members together, as well as our annual end-of-year gala, Barrio Fiesta.

The Finance department is all business. They manage, oversee, and report on all club funds, making sure every dollar is accounted for. They also host fundraisers, with the proceeds allocated across KABA initiatives.

The Internals department keeps KABA cozy. They handle executive relations and club memberships, and plan our annual executive retreat, executive socials, and community engagement, so everyone feels right at home.

The Externals department takes KABA beyond the trailhead. They hold philanthropic events for non-profit organisations in the Philippines and develop and maintain sponsorships throughout the year. They also represent the club in the Association of Southeast Asian Clubs in UBC and keep in touch with club alumni.

Class is in session! The Academic department develops programs that enhance members’ professional, academic, and wellness development. They maintain the club’s correspondence with industry professionals and start projects that showcase Filipino culture and identity.
The Student Life department brings the swag to every KABA social. They manage our major events, including the KABArkada program, Icebreaker events, Halloween, and our annual FSA event, KABAlympics.

The Communications department is always cooking. They serve up the vibrant Filipino culture through the KABA website and all other forms of media. Split into two branches, Creatives and Marketing, they take charge of promotions and publicity for all of the club’s initiatives.
